text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > docs/CHAT_UI_CORRECTION_VERIFICATION.md <<'EOF'
# Reopened chat UI correction — verification and integration

This is a corrective release candidate, **not full acceptance of the reopened workflow**. The UI defects described below are corrected and independently browser-reviewed. Fresh live window-count questions reached existing QA but failed in provider calls; one live source intent also timed out. These failures remain open and are not erased by fixture passes or historical successful retries.

## Base, coordination and ownership

All original UI commits through `9b20a0b` had already been integrated. This work uses `/tmp/junction-chat-ui-corrections`, branch `feat/chat-ui-corrections`, from main `9a001f3`. Main's reviewed `37c4dd1` was cherry-picked as `fe44534` before controller edits, preserving its mapping notices, submitted-value attribution, model-poll join and comparison-layer fixes. No other worktree was modified or pushed. Main owns integration/deployment, provider transport/settings, QA, reconstruction/refinement, persistence and public access.

The reviewed plan is [CHAT_UI_CORRECTION_PLAN.md](CHAT_UI_CORRECTION_PLAN.md); the updated contract is [CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md](CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md). Main agreed the narrow routing and ownership changes in `/tmp/junction-ui-coordination.md`. Existing public access, exact example revision pins, immutable models, provider switch and all operation endpoints remain intact. No new dependency, inference runtime, format, model, timeout, retry or processing budget.

## Failures reproduced and corrected

- Exact “How many windows does this building have?” on actual saved1794 and11397 produced valid live `question` actions with an `all`/window selector. The old resolver incorrectly required exactly one object and returned clarification instead of QA. General selectors now preserve original wording/document revision and delegate to existing source QA; no mesh/inventory count becomes an answer. Explicit focused/named references remain validated and revision-pinned.
- Physical orbit/wheel during a delayed valid question changed navigation epoch and discarded the entire response, with zero QA submissions. Questions now have a captured document/revision/reply lifetime independent of viewer movement. Mixed batches suppress stale camera/navigation effects only. Genuine cross-document visits, forged responses and stale mutations remain rejected.
- A no-selector whole-blueprint request now opens a whole supplied page with `bbox:null`, not an implicit selected object. Source/page controls are direct and revision-aware. Failed image preloads retain the previous view. Old source citations never borrow current page labels/bounds or current user values.
- Persistent Blueprints/3D model/Return to selection, page choices, themes and independent overlays work without intent inference. No-model tabs do not reconstruct. An explicit build action still uses the existing operation. Provider-unavailable local mode retains the visible saved-building entry point.
- Selected-object evidence is persistent outside chat scrolling. Presence, representation, property origin, object/floor assumptions, matching-revision user inputs and exact source links remain visible with overlays off. The legend distinguishes observations, interpretations, derivations, user values, assumptions, unresolved records and non-factual proposals. A source link does not validate every property. A markers use actual selected/highlighted meshes; unresolved records have no fabricated mesh.
- Review found that disabling selection highlight left clicked-object emissive styling visible. The new appearance flag suppresses inspection/concept selection styling while retaining the selected ID, source and camera. Answer highlights and assumptions remain independent.
- Review also found stale clarification responses could hijack a later free-text request. Clarifications/suggestions are request-bound; older responses cannot take over newer input.
- Main's fresh1732 findings are covered: restored answers retain job/request identity to avoid duplicate cards after polling; workspace headers use existing terminal outcome labels; terminal failures remove pending-model progress without deleting job/evidence history.

## Credential-safe diagnosis and remaining live failures

The historical generic count exception cannot be reconstructed: the old boundary discarded its cause. We do not claim the plural-selector fix proves that exception's root cause. The additive router now emits one safe diagnostic per failing invocation: application-generated reference, stage, exception class, schema-known field paths/error types and numeric HTTP status where available. Unknown JSON keys, prompt/request IDs, bodies, source text and exception messages are excluded. # Public demo verification — 2026-11-14

The application is deployed at https://95.133.254.90.sslip.io on one Verda CPU VM with persistent storage. This report distinguishes public live verification, cached-artifact inspection and deterministic tests. Deployment details, resource IDs and manual export/teardown instructions are in [VERDA_DEPLOYMENT.md](VERDA_DEPLOYMENT.md). No push was performed.

## Access and examples

Nine pinned examples are public. A shared code unlocks paid Gemini QA, uploads and private work. Code holders share a workspace; these are not private per-user accounts. The prepared example sources/model revisions remain immutable even after unlocking. Their original-source QA is allowed against the pinned revision.

The operator's code is stored locally in `/tmp/junction-verda/private-deployment/demo-access-code.txt`; it is not committed or sent to browser storage. The service receives only a salted verifier and session secret, with Gemini credentials kept server-side. Cloud credentials remain on the operator's machine.

The selection contains 3181, 34, 11397, 1794, church 22921604, unseen 10262, religious SVG 14661814, KIT institute PDF and the original duplex IFC. Eight are derived models; the duplex is supplied native IFC evidence. Saved review failures/findings were preserved. “Reviewed” does not mean accurate or complete.

Independent Chromium review used normal certificate validation against the public hostname, not localhost. All nine examples loaded the exact selected revision, could be orbited and supported source clicks. Floor controls, separate assumptions and original-coordinate overlays worked. Native object evidence returned the original GlobalId record. No unexpected browser mutation calls or JavaScript errors were recorded.

Access verification confirmed anonymous QA/chat rejection, hidden private history and unknown revisions, and rejected reconstruction/extraction of shared examples even after unlocking. The session cookie is Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite Strict. The code was absent from local/session storage. Locking reloads the app and clears the private selection/model. A five-second observer initially timed out during network reload; a longer observation confirmed the reload completed, without an application change.

## Live public Gemini checks

These used the deployed UI, real intent routing and the existing source-based QA pipeline; no fake provider or cached answer was substituted. Token usage below is the QA answer's recorded usage; end-to-end duration also includes routing and polling and must not be treated as provider-only latency.

| Original | Check | Result | End-to-end time | QA input/output tokens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1794 | Identify the balcony's original label | Answered, two page-region citations, one validated object highlight; citation opened original source | 33.31 s | 60,344 / 1,051 |
| 11397 | Actual first-floor clear ceiling height from original only | Insufficient; one source citation, no invented height or highlight despite visible extrusion | 30.40 s | 56,646 / 724 |

On updated release `a470a11`, unchanged 1732 was uploaded as a new private building. Its extraction job was observed queued, the browser was refreshed, and the saved building was reopened. Interpretation completed in 19.29 seconds (1,943 input / 2,271 output tokens). A source-only entrance-label question then answered in 29.25 seconds (34,728 input / 1,686 output tokens), before optional geometry.

Optional geometry took 331.44 seconds (73,504 input / 57,616 output tokens across its recorded calls). It generated a usable preview, then source review rejected the proposed correction: the job finished `needs_attention` with that preview retained. This is an accurately reported partial outcome, not completed model review. No blind retry or model substitution followed.

Independent public browser inspection of retained revision `d009e9abbb494136ab8d38780d7dd24a` verified orbit, original-revision source clicks, eight assumption rows and saved source-only QA. It has 29 semantic records, 24 meshes and five unresolved openings. All labeled spaces and seven schematic furnishings/fixtures are represented, but the two windows and three doors lack hosts; walls remain solid at those openings. The fridge/freezer and bathroom shaft are missing. Initial 30-second reopen observations expired with the document already set and the UI busy; later traced requests all returned 200 and the model opened. The exact delay cause remains unisolated.

The actual public 1732 IFC download reopened locally, then was reimported through the public browser. All 29 object IDs, source references, assumptions and relative units matched; one original page remained embedded. Identical original reupload reused the saved interpretation/model without another job. These operations issued only authentication/upload requests, with zero provider calls and zero browser errors. Separately, the public 11397 IFC download reopened with all 22 IDs, source references, assumptions and relative units preserved.

Post-upload server restart passed: all 516 persistent file hashes, all CURRENT pointers and five jobs were unchanged across 11 saved buildings (nine examples plus the private original/reimport). All 436 seed files remained intact, persistent storage stayed mounted and no inference job was created. Anonymous users still saw exactly nine examples; both private buildings returned 404. A subsequent trusted-HTTPS browser session reopened the original's retained model in 8.77 seconds and the imported IFC in 2.15 seconds, each with 29 records/24 meshes, matching revisions and relative units. Only authentication was posted; no provider calls or JavaScript errors occurred.

## Fidelity limitations

Actual reopened IFC overlays still expose missing or misplaced geometry. The 3181 model retains a wall crossing the bed/bedroom. 11397 has sparse interior geometry. The religious SVG lacks curved features and columns; the institute model misses facade windows. The institute's legacy IFC retains relative display units despite a description calibration; it must not be represented as measured geometry. The unseen 10262 model fills an upper open volume as a room floor. Church full geometry recovery still fails strict checks; a previous usable partial model remains available.

Zero unresolved records is not a completeness score. Generated geometry, assumed heights and user inputs remain distinct from original evidence. This deployment does not claim that every reconstructed building is faithful or that the earlier church recovery acceptance has passed.

The fresh-building browser review also found presentation defects: the workspace header retains the revision's `preview reviewing` label after the job has finished `needs_attention`; a pending-model note remains alongside the accurate terminal job message; reopening can duplicate the single persisted answer card without another QA call. These were routed with reproduction evidence to the separate UI corrective worktree. They are not claimed fixed in `a470a11`. The exact history deduplication defect is missing job/request identity on restored answer cards, allowing the next job poll to append a second card.

## Reliability checkpoint

Independent review cleared the bounded chat fixes in `37c4dd1`: wait for an in-flight completed-model fetch, retain navigation staleness checks, show submitted input scope/reason and attribution, disclose unmapped/off-floor answers, and toggle comparison layers independently. No provider, geometry or sufficiency behavior changed. Browser fixtures exercise UI contracts; they do not establish live extraction fidelity.

The full browser-enabled regression suite passed **760 tests with one optional test skipped** in 288.61 seconds. The environment doctor passed. The independent reviewer separately passed 17 focused tests and directly rechecked deployed `a470a11`: the restored 1794 answer highlights one object while 37 surroundings fade to 10% opacity; the 11397 refusal has no invented highlights. Turning off the spaces comparison layer preserves wall overlays and the overall comparison.

The initial server restart preserved all 436 prepared seed-file hashes and all nine examples with zero provider calls. The code-only update to `a470a11` then preserved all 440 persistent files, including both live QA jobs and history, without reseeding or replacing credentials. The installer now waits for readiness for up to 60 seconds after service start; that is an operator verification timeout, not a new limit on uploaded drawings or inference jobs. Existing application processing budgets remain unchanged.

Private verification artifacts are under `/tmp/junction-verda/public-browser-review` and `/tmp/junction-verda/public-acceptance`; these include source imagery and generated responses and are not committed.

content.text:
Implement a chat-first UI redesign in this isolated worktree. The main session is separately improving reconstruction and refinement reliability. Keep those efforts independent, agree on shared interfaces, and do not duplicate or rewrite its pipelines.

Use planning, independent plan review, bounded implementation and independent implementation review. Reviewers must directly interact with the browser. Make focused commits; do not push or modify the other worktree.

Read AGENTS.md and the current product, source-first, reconstruction and handoff documentation before implementation.

### Product direction

Create a minimal interface using the actual light and dark colour schemes from my Chronicle project. Locate its theme files; if unavailable, ask for their location rather than inventing an approximation.

Initially, show a clean chat interface with blueprint attachments. When visual inspection is requested, move chat to the left and reveal a workspace on the right.

All application operations should be accessible through conversation. Keep manual orbit, zoom and pan. Citations and compact action controls may appear inside chat; avoid separate toolbars, floor selectors and settings panels.

### Target workflow

Support this conversational sequence:

1. Upload blueprint(s).
2. Show “Reading your drawings…” while originals are saved and Gemini creates a validated interpretation.
3. Show that the drawings are ready; source-grounded QA works before 3D.
4. “Show me all windows in the 3D model.”
   - Reuse the current saved model, or invoke the existing reconstruction workflow.
   - Show progress in chat.
   - Open the workspace, highlight reliably associated modeled windows, fade other geometry and frame the selection.
5. “Show this from above.”
   - Move the camera to top-down while preserving selection.
6. “Show the windows individually.”
   - Start a tour that focuses each selected window with a useful close-up orientation.
7. “Show this window in the original blueprint.”
   - Immediately pause the tour and capture the focused object when the message is submitted.
   - Open its original page and highlight its stored evidence region.
8. “Back to the model; next window.”
   - Restore the model and continue the same tour.
9. A requested refinement uses the existing attributed-input, validation and review workflow. Accepted changes update the workspace; rejected changes retain the previous usable model and explain the outcome.

### Architecture

Maintain explicit workspace state: document/revision, view mode, selected IDs, focused ID, camera, tour position, highlighting and assumption visibility.

Use:

Message + captured workspace context → typed action → validation → existing operation → updated chat/workspace

Gemini interprets language; application code resolves and validates identities; deterministic viewer code controls selection, cameras, tours and source navigation. Do not require a VLM to rediscover the focused object from screenshots.

Distinguish navigation commands, factual questions and persistent refinements. Navigation should not unnecessarily invoke the factual QA pipeline. Ask focused clarifications for genuine ambiguity; avoid blanket confirmation steps.

Agree on a small action/result contract before dependent implementation. Own frontend presentation and viewer interaction. Coordinate any backend routing changes with the main session. Do not add a new agent runtime or parallel implementation of reconstruction, QA or persistence.

### Preserve correctness

- Keep Gemini, the provider switch, source-sufficiency gate, citations and refusals.
- Preserve original coordinates, stable IDs, revision-pinned evidence, cached models and portable IFC provenance.
- Generated geometry and display assumptions never become authoritative factual evidence.
- Keep answer highlighting and assumption visibility independently controllable through chat.
- “All modeled windows” must not imply complete extraction of every real window.
- Unresolved objects retain source evidence; never fabricate meshes, matches or tighter source regions.
- Use reliable geometry/host orientation for close-ups; label uncertain orientations appropriately.
- Preserve original labels and building-type agnosticism.
- Keep failed operations and partial models visibly distinguishable from completed, reviewed results.

### Verification and scope

Start with deterministic interaction fixtures to establish layout, navigation and interruption behavior. Clearly distinguish fixtures from real inference. Then verify the workflow against actual saved models and real backend responses.

Independent browser review must exercise both themes, chat/workspace transitions, selections, camera changes, tours, interruption with “this object,” source navigation, assumptions and recoverable failures. Use a real model with renderable windows where available; separately test unresolved objects honestly.

Reuse existing capabilities first. No new formats, models, rendering engines, photorealism or infrastructure. Explain new constraints before introducing them.

Deliver the reviewed implementation, action contract, focused commits and a handoff stating what was verified with fixtures, actual artifacts and live providers, plus remaining gaps.

Use planning, independent plan review, bounded implementation and independent implementation review. Reviewers must directly interact with the browser. Make focused commits; do not push or modify the other worktree.

Read AGENTS.md and the current product, source-first, reconstruction and handoff documentation before implementation.

### Product direction

Create a minimal interface using the actual light and dark colour schemes from my Chronicle project. Locate its theme files; if unavailable, ask for their location rather than inventing an approximation.

Initially, show a clean chat interface with blueprint attachments. When visual inspection is requested, move chat to the left and reveal a workspace on the right.

All application operations should be accessible through conversation. Keep manual orbit, zoom and pan. Citations and compact action controls may appear inside chat; avoid separate toolbars, floor selectors and settings panels.

### Target workflow

Support this conversational sequence:

1. Upload blueprint(s).
2. Show “Reading your drawings…” while originals are saved and Gemini creates a validated interpretation.
3. Show that the drawings are ready; source-grounded QA works before 3D.
4. “Show me all windows in the 3D model.”
   - Reuse the current saved model, or invoke the existing reconstruction workflow.
   - Show progress in chat.
   - Open the workspace, highlight reliably associated modeled windows, fade other geometry and frame the selection.
5. “Show this from abov<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="431" />## Preserve correctness

- Keep Gemini, the provider switch, source-sufficiency gate, citations and refusals.
- Preserve original coordinates, stable IDs, revision-pinned evidence, cached models and portable IFC provenance.
- Generated geometry and display assumptions never become authoritative factual evidence.
- Keep answer highlighting and assumption visibility independently controllable through chat.

- Unresolved objects retain source evidence; never fabricate meshes, matches or tighter source regions.
- Use reliable geometry/host orientation for close-ups; label uncertain orientations appropriately.
- Preserve original labels and building-type agnosticism.
- Keep failed operations and partial models visibly distinguishable from completed, reviewed results.

### Verification and scope

Start with deterministic interaction fixtures to establish layout, navigation and interruption behavior. Clearly distinguish fixtures from real inference. Then verify the workflow against actual saved models and real backend responses.

Independent browser review must exercise both themes, chat/workspace transitions, selections, camera changes, tours, interruption with “this object,” source navigation, assumptions and recoverable failures. Use a real model with renderable windows where available; separately test unresolved objects honestly.

Reuse existing capabilities first. No new formats, models, rendering engines, photorealism or infrastructure. Explain new constraints before introducing them.

Deliver the reviewed implementation, action contract, focused commits and a handoff stating what was verified with fixtures, actual artifacts and live providers, plus remaining gaps.

# Reopened chat UI correction — verification and integration

This is a corrective release candidate, **not full acceptance of the reopened workflow**. The UI defects described below are corrected and independently browser-reviewed. Fresh live window-count questions reached existing QA but failed in provider calls; one live source intent also timed out. These failures remain open and are not erased by fixture passes or historical successful retries.

## Base, coordination and ownership

All original UI commits through `9b20a0b` had already been integrated. This work uses `/tmp/junction-chat-ui-corrections`, branch `feat/chat-ui-corrections`, from main `9a001f3`. Main's reviewed `37c4dd1` was cherry-picked as `fe44534` before controller edits, preserving its mapping notices, submitted-value attribution, model-poll join and comparison-layer fixes. No other worktree was modified or pushed. Main owns integration/deployment, provider transport/settings, QA, reconstruction/refinement, persistence and public access.

The reviewed plan is [CHAT_UI_CORRECTION_PLAN.md](CHAT_UI_CORRECTION_PLAN.md); the updated contract is [CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md](CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md). Main agreed the narrow routing and ownership changes in `/tmp/junction-ui-coordination.md`. Existing public access, exact example revision pins, immutable models, provider switch and all operation endpoints remain intact. No new dependency, inference runtime, format, model, timeout, retry or processing budget.

## Failures reproduced and corrected

- Exact “How many windows does this building have?” on actual saved1794 and11397 produced valid live `question` actions with an `all`/window selector. The old resolver incorrectly required exactly one object and returned clarification instead of QA. General selectors now preserve original wording/document revision and delegate to existing source QA; no mesh/inventory count becomes an answer. Explicit focused/named references remain validated and revision-pinned.
- Physical orbit/wheel during a delayed valid question changed navigation epoch and discarded the entire response, with zero QA submissions. Questions now have a captured document/revision/reply lifetime independent of viewer movement. Mixed batches suppress stale camera/navigation effects only. Genuine cross-document visits, forged responses and stale mutations remain rejected.
- A no-selector whole-blueprint request now opens a whole supplied page with `bbox:null`, not an implicit selected object. Source/page controls are direct and revision-aware. Failed image preloads retain the previous view. Old source citations never borrow current page labels/bounds or current user values.
- Persistent Blueprints/3D model/Return to selection, page choices, themes and independent overlays work without intent inference. No-model tabs do not reconstruct. An explicit build action still uses the existing operation. Provider-unavailable local mode retains the visible saved-building entry point.
- Selected-object evidence is persistent outside chat scrolling. Presence, representation, property origin, object/floor assumptions, matching-revision user inputs and exact source links remain visible with overlays off. The legend distinguishes observations, interpretations, derivations, user values, assumptions, unresolved records and non-factual proposals. A source link does not validate every property. A markers use actual selected/highlighted meshes; unresolved records have no fabricated mesh.
- Review found that disabling selection highlight left clicked-object emissive styling visible. The new appearance flag suppresses inspection/concept selection styling while retaining the selected ID, source and camera. Answer highlights and assumptions remain independent.
- Review also found stale clarification responses could hijack a later free-text request. Clarifications/suggestions are request-bound; older responses cannot take over newer input.
- Main's fresh1732 findings are covered: restored answers retain job/request identity to avoid duplicate cards after polling; workspace headers use existing terminal outcome labels; terminal failures remove pending-model progress without deleting job/evidence history.

## Credential-safe diagnosis and remaining live failures

The historical generic count exception cannot be reconstructed: the old boundary discarded its cause. We do not claim the plural-selector fix proves that exception's root cause. The additive router now emits one safe diagnostic per failing invocation: application-generated reference, stage, exception class, schema-known field paths/error types and numeric HTTP status where available. Unknown JSON keys, prompt/request IDs, bodies, source text and exception messages are excluded. The generic response includes the reference. `httpx.TimeoutException` receives an explicit timeout outcome; no retry or evidence-insufficiency conclusion is added.

Fresh live Gemini browser runs used unchanged actual saved originals/models and current configured providers:

| Actual run | Observed outcome |
|---|---|
| saved11397, no selected object, “Show the original blueprint” | Valid source action in9.49s; pinned whole original opened without an invented region. |
| saved11397, exact window-count question during physical orbit/wheel and source/model switches | Valid question action in9.26s and exactly one QA submission. QuestionIntent and source gate validated; DraftAnswer provider call failed after44.901s against its existing45s timeout. No answer/evidence conclusion. |
| saved1794, same whole-blueprint request | Valid source action in9.77s; exact original opened. |
| saved1794, exact count during the same combined interactions | Valid question action in11.61s and one QA submission. Existing QA QuestionIntent failed with provider_error after58.896s; no finish/tokens returned. No answer/evidence conclusion. |
| saved11397, tour then “Show this window in the original blueprint.” | Intent HTTP502after46.95s. Safe log captured `provider_response / ReadTimeout`; no action executed, model/source retained. |

Thus **fresh successful end-to-end count QA and live tour/source continuation are not established in this pass**. Count routing and navigation concurrency are demonstrated separately from provider completion. These failures were sent to the main session with private job/call metadata; no core files or limits were changed to hide them, and further blind retries stopped.

Private evidence: `/tmp/chat-ui-correction-diagnosis/` (three baseline semantic probes), `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-live/report.json`, `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-live-1794/report.json` plus `failure-stages.json`, and `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-tour-live/report.json`. These contain verification records, not runtime fixtures or fallback logic.

## Independent actual-browser evidence

The reviewer directly used Chromium, actual saved11397/1794 originals and geometry, and a separately imported previously accepted11397 with user-supplied1.6relative height. Intent/QA delays in combined race checks were explicitly deterministic fixtures, not inference. Reports are under `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-review/`:

- `combined-report.json`: whole-page no-focus view; camera/tour-preserving source/model switches; captured focused QA through physical orbit, changed selection and stale mixed navigation; exact source regions; both themes and narrow layout; recoverable source failure; zero reconstruction and JavaScript errors.
- `provenance-report.json`: actual accepted user height, independent overlays, exact source revision/bbox, actual unresolved objects and decorative proposals without changing source counts.
- `old-source-report.json`: two real stored revisions; old exact citation retained while current input rows are excluded; current whole-page browsing remains unhighlighted.
- `selection-highlight-report.json`: retained selected ID with appearance disabled; independent answer state.
- `public-browser-report.json`: real local public middleware plus an actual pinned example, test-only access credentials and a provider that cannot run. Anonymous direct controls work, no conversation request, intent401, unlock without replay, immutable mutation409, zero provider calls. This is not a public deployment test.
- `logging-boundary-report.json`: unexpected outer-boundary failure is logged once with a correlated reference; private exception values redacted and provider closed.

Final rechecks and aggregate test totals follow below. Independent reviewers did not implement reviewed changes.

## Artifact integrity

Real HTTP export checks on saved1794, saved11397 and the accepted-height11397 all remain byte-identical to their imported IFCs, drawing-derived, with unchanged model revision and zero extraction/reconstruction/refinement jobs. Original source navigation uses stored coordinates and revisions. Evidence: `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-artifacts.json`. The accepted-height file was imported from an existing reviewed artifact; no new refinement inference was performed here.

Multi-page/source discovery, no-model states, stale mutation guards and precise asynchronous races also use explicitly labeled deterministic fixtures. This pass does not establish new extraction/reconstruction fidelity, live OpenAI behavior, successful fresh count inference, or deployment acceptance.

Local commits: `2525c8a` reviewed plan/contract; `258fe74` deterministic viewer; `cf7ed66` additive intent route; `0068ebf` Chronicle chat UI; `e9cb6a8` focused-source wire repair. Required deterministic suite: 563 passed, 35 optional skipped. New Chromium suite: 10 passed. Independent direct browser review on actual saved11397 and native duplex, both themes, is clear; private report `/tmp/chat-ui-review/REVIEW.md`. No pushes or edits to the main worktree. Main reliability commits remain independent; UI ports their recovery-event/evidence/base-revision and submitted-value semantics.

Live Gemini exposed a repeatable wrong source action with the broad typed union. Prompt clarification alone did not fix it. The additive router now uses a single action-type wire enum plus optional typed fields, then revalidates through strict operation-specific schemas; unrelated fields are rejected. Configured provider, model and one-call boundary remain unchanged. Targeted live source action now resolves the exact captured object. Full live sequence and original-source QA verification are finishing; final report will be `docs/CHAT_UI_VERIFICATION.md` in UI branch. Direct thread notification was unavailable (local tool transport), so this shared file remains the coordination record.

## UI integration readiness / deployment-snapshot reply

Implementation is ready. Full live Gemini chain now passes: select saved11397 windows, top-down, tour, captured exact original region, back/next, theme, original-height QA refusal. Report `/tmp/chat-ui-live-browser/report.json` says complete=true, console_errors=[]. Accepted/rejected refinements also pass real existing HTTP/job runner/generation/browser polling on unchanged1794, using explicitly deterministic injected review judgments (no new live refinement inference). All review blockers cleared. Final supported-QA citation smoke and handoff documentation are finishing; no functional changes pending.

For the deployment snapshot, cherry-pick the UI commits in the listed order into the deployment integration branch; resolve the small app.js conflict by keeping the new chat hooks and its ported recovery semantics. Do not restore old app.js wholesale. Source selectors resolve authoritative IDs in the selected building/revision; focused evidence pins geometry revision; persistent actions carry captured current base revisions. **No public visitor isolation/auth/control was added here.** Existing /api/buildings lists the store and open_saved consumes that catalog. The deployment root must scope those catalogs/routes and clone or protect shared examples before allowing mutations; the chat action route is not an authorization boundary. No deployment files or other worktrees were modified by the UI task.

Its existing request helper displays 401 as an operational error and does not silently retry or mutate. It does not yet contain an unlock form, template-copy action or public-example metadata, because those contracts are still being planned by the main session. Keep that deployment integration separately owned; supply exact 401/ unlock/copy DTOs before dependent frontend work. Do not treat the local branch as public-access ready. Core UI commits above are ready now; final handoff/docs commit will follow. Direct notification tool still fails to connect to its old local MCP endpoint; this file is the available reply channel.

## Reliability checkpoint update

Main-session commits are now `f932467` (patch contracts/target authority), `3064e21` (job recovery and UI outcome semantics), and `5f6eb51` (fresh delta-uncertainty assessment and carried-finding deduplication). These are local commits, not pushed. Existing public routes and mutation DTOs remain unchanged. The latest assessment-field change is server-owned; UI must continue displaying accepted/retained outcomes and unresolved findings independently. Live recovery acceptance is still in progress; these commits are not a claim of complete reconstruction fidelity.

## UI final-check status / public contract received

Received public contract: GET /api/access {public_demo,can_work}; POST /api/access/unlock {code} cookie; POST /api/access/lock; descriptors public_example/read_only_model; public conversation 401; paid chat/actions protected; no copy workflow. Reviewer /root/corrective_reviewer, read-only product review. Evidence uses isolated corrective checkout/server34552 and private copied stores. No live provider requests by this reviewer. Original UI handoff is historical, not current acceptance.

Current status: direct browser checks below pass; outstanding final recheck is the late intent-clarification race reported below. # Chat actions and workspace contract

Corrective branch `feat/chat-ui-corrections`, worktree `/tmp/junction-chat-ui-corrections`, starts at integrated main `9a001f3` and incorporates main's reviewed `37c4dd1` as `fe44534`. The original `feat/chat-first-ui` commits through `9b20a0b` were already integrated. Coordination lives at `/tmp/junction-ui-coordination.md`. This additive boundary never replaces extraction, QA, refinement, persistence or reconstruction. Main session owns those pipelines and public-access enforcement. The reopened user requirements supersede the earlier chat-only controls restriction and prior acceptance.

## Request and result

`POST /api/chat/actions` takes `{message,request_id,document_id:null|string,revision_id:null|string,workspace:{geometry_revision_id:null|string,view_mode:"chat|source|model|concept",selected_ids:[],focused_id:null|string,camera:null|object,tour:{ids:[],index:-1,running:false},navigation_epoch:0,highlighting:true,answer_highlighting:true,show_assumptions:false,floor_id:null|string,exploded:false,cutaway:100}}`.

Capture and deep-copy workspace synchronously at submit; pause timer before awaiting. Also capture the document visit epoch and QA reply/clarification context. A request does not accept client object names, source boxes or screenshots as evidence. `revision_id` means current interpretation; `geometry_revision_id` means displayed saved geometry. Camera uses viewer `getCameraState()`; damping is not a navigation epoch change. User submissions, compact navigation and manual viewer interaction invalidate older navigation effects, **not factual question execution**. Polls and expected reconstruction swaps do not falsely invalidate their pending action.

Validate all echoed identities before dispatch. Factual questions execute once against their captured document/revision/reference despite orbit, zoom, pan, source/model switches or a later selection. Mixed batches dispatch captured questions independently and suppress stale navigation only. A different document visit (including A → B → A) rejects undispatched work; already submitted jobs remain persisted in their captured building and cannot populate another building's view. Persistent mutations retain captured base revisions and final server validation; camera movement never rebases them. Visibility/theme controls preserve the tour and do not invalidate navigation. QA completion cannot change the camera, tab or selection.

Response echoes `request_id,document_id,revision_id,geometry_revision_id,navigation_epoch` and adds `{status:"ready|clarification",actions:[],message,clarification:null|{message,suggestions:[]},usage:{}}`. Message is a deterministic operation summary; factual output only comes from reviewed QA. Clarification concerns intent, never the evidence-sufficiency gate. Operational errors retain existing safe HTTP detail format; 409 means stale context. One selected-provider structured call, existing timeout/output budget, no retry/fallback. Known compact actions execute locally without interpretation.

Provider transport uses `WireChatIntent`: one action-type enum with nullable typed fields. Null fields are removed before strict operation-specific validation; unrelated non-null fields fail rather than being silently discarded. This avoids the broad-union branch ambiguity observed in live Gemini source navigation without changing the public action contract or provider implementation.

## Typed actions

Every action has a literal `type`. Optional keys below default to null/empty. Unknown types/keys and invalid references fail validation.

| Type | Fields / behavior |
|---|---|
| `show_model` | Reuse cached scene or await existing reconstruction; preserve active tour. |
| `select` | `selector:{target:"focused|selection|all|named",kind:null|string,label:null|string,floor:null|string,ids:[]}`, server outputs `ids`, `unresolved_ids`, `deferred` (bool). Empty scene permits only semantic deferred selector; resolve after actual geometry arrives. No fabricated IDs. |
| `show_source` | No selector/page opens the first supplied **whole original page** at captured interpretation revision, with `bbox:null` and no object. Explicit `page` validates against that revision. Explicit object `selector` opens exact saved evidence at captured geometry revision. Native object source opens record inspector; native whole-source requests offer original-record guidance. |
| `close_workspace` | Retain model/camera/tour paused. |
| `set_camera` | `preset:"top|fit|isometric"`; preserve selections. |
| `tour` | `command:"start|pause|resume|next|previous"`; start uses navigation selected IDs, excludes unrenderable records. End stops without cycling. |
| `set_visibility` | `target:"answer_highlights|navigation_highlights|assumptions"`, `enabled:boolean`. Independent state. |
| `set_view` | `mode:"model|concept|source"`. |
| `set_floor` | `floor_id` resolved server-side, null means all; model may propose `label`. |
| `set_separation` | `enabled:boolean`. |
| `set_cutaway` | `percent:number` in existing 0–100 domain. |
| `set_theme` | `theme:"light|dark|system"`. Exact Chronicle tokens. |
| `question` | `question:string`, `revision_id`, `navigation_reference:null|{object_id,source,source_revision_id}`; original message preserved. A general `all`/kind selector is question scope, not a demand to resolve one object or count modeled IDs. For a focused/named singular question append a deterministic clearly labeled navigation reference to existing question text and pin its source revision. Do not introduce an AskRequest field or model-authored factual paraphrase. Respect its existing text length bound. |
| `refine` | `edits` is existing UserEdit batch, `supporting_source_ids:[]`; server validates with existing prepare_inputs without publication. Final execution sends existing RefinementRequest with current captured base. |
| `reconstruct` | `mode:"refine|reconstruct"`; reuse existing job route. |
| `list_saved` | Show saved choices in chat. |
| `open_saved` | `building_id` validated against saved catalog; model may propose `label`. |
| `attach_sources` / `new_upload` | Native file chooser from compact chat control. Existing upload/append routes. |
| `download_ifc` | Existing saved artifact URL; derived provenance unchanged. |
| `download_source` | `source_id` validated; ambiguity asks which source. |
| `retry_extraction` / `refresh` | Existing endpoints. |
| `stop_job` | `job_id` validated against selected building; ambiguity asks which job. |
| `inspect_assumptions` / `inspect_inventory` | Source-linked rows in chat, not a settings panel; no mesh for unresolved records. |
| `set_comparison` | `enabled:boolean`, optional `layer:"spaces|walls|openings|features|unresolved"`, optional `opacity` in the existing 10–90 percent control range; uses the existing actual-IFC source overlay. |
| `help` | Compact examples and available operations in chat. |

Model selectors resolve exact saved IDs/labels/kinds/floors in code. Duplicate labels clarify. Saved modeled-window selection reports coverage as modeled records, not all real/source windows. Source boxes are copied unchanged; never synthesized tighter boxes. Focused removed objects retain old source evidence, but persistent edits must target current surviving identities. No nearest-object or list-index substitution.

Persistent numeric edits must be explicitly attributed to an adjacent quantity/unit pair in the submitted message (digits and common English number words are supported). Calibration requires explicit normalized original-page endpoints; the navigation catalog cannot establish them. Unsupported phrasing clarifies. Any supplied edit source must exactly match a scoped saved source region. Existing attributed-input validation and review remain the final mutation authority.

Execute actions in order, stopping dependent actions on failure. A deferred selector waits for the explicitly requested reconstruction, then resolves using actual new scene records and checks the request/document/navigation epoch. Partial preview and failed review are reported honestly; no automatic extra reconstruction loop. Revision replacements use existing atomic viewer swap; revalidate tour IDs and pause/report lost targets. Source mode retains ordered IDs/index and model camera so back/next advances exactly once.

Question actions are independent of navigation dependencies as described above; the original ordering rule applies to dependent navigation/mutation actions. General factual QA always uses the existing source pipeline, not inventory/mesh counts. Source navigation, public browsing and QA never implicitly reconstruct.

## Viewer interface

`getCameraState()` / `setCameraState(snapshot)`; `frameIds(ids,{topDown:false}) -> {framed_ids,unavailable_ids}`; `focusObject(id) -> {focused_id,orientation:"geometry|uncertain|unavailable",note}`; `setTheme("light|dark")`. Existing select, setHighlights, setHighlightsEnabled, setShowAssumptions, setFloorFilter, setExploded, setMode and cutaway methods remain. Geometry covariance can establish a window axis; it does not establish exterior side. Ambiguous axes use a labeled approximate oblique camera. Z-up orbit remains; top-down respects the existing numerical polar epsilon.

`setSelectionHighlightEnabled(boolean)` hides clicked-object selection appearance in both inspection/concept without clearing its ID or evidence; answer highlights and assumption overlays remain independent. Assumption tint reuses existing fields. A markers identify stored assumed properties on selected/highlighted geometry; they never create source matches. Unresolved ? markers retain their existing source-only semantics.

Client-only direct controls use `browse_source{page?,source_revision_id?}`, `switch_model` and `return_selection`. They do not call Gemini. `switch_model` only reuses a saved scene; absence shows an explicit Build model action using the existing pipeline. `return_selection` explicitly frames current IDs; ordinary tab switches preserve camera/tour position. `chatUI.inspection()` returns a copied selected record, floor, units, source revision and removed status (or non-factual proposal/host). `chatUI.sourceView()` returns the active pinned page catalog/revision/page. `blueprint:workspace` notifies the read-only controls module; it does not introduce another state owner.

Cache supplied page catalogs by revision during a document visit. If an old citation lacks a locally known catalog, open only its exact cited page and derive image dimensions from the successful original-image read; do not borrow current filenames/coordinates. Preload before committing a source switch; failed reads retain the previous view. The Blueprints tab browses current originals; the page chooser follows the active source revision. Comparisons from another geometry revision are hidden rather than overlaid on older evidence.

## Presentation and compatibility

Navigation turns/progress are ephemeral UI records retained across server conversation refresh, separate from persisted factual conversation. Answers are rendered once with citations and expandable existing checks. Saved building/job state remains backend-owned. Recovery events and submitted values are not evidence of publication: preserve labels and event.base_revision_id source pins. Failed/stopped/needs_attention outcomes retain usable models and original sources.

Persistent compact controls expose view/page navigation, current selection, theme and independent toggles. A selected-evidence summary remains outside chat scrolling and independent of overlays: presence, representation, property origins, object/floor assumptions, pinned user inputs and exact Show in original links. Current assumption rows are attached only when their data revision matches the selected record; older floors retain captured units. Supported presence/registration cannot establish height or vertical placement. The legend distinguishes observation, interpretation, derivation, user-provided values, display assumptions, unresolved values and non-factual proposals.

Intent failures emit one credential-safe diagnostic with an application-generated reference, stage, exception class, schema-known validation paths/types, and numeric HTTP status when available. Unknown field names, messages, request IDs, request/response bodies and source text are excluded. The generic operational response carries that reference; no automatic retry, fallback, budget increase or evidence conclusion is added. Public paid-action gates, immutable example pins and access-code/no-replay behavior are unchanged.

Chronicle tokens originate at `https://github.com/Programmercloud-cmd/AI_Chronicle_UI/blob/main/src/web/styles/global.css`, blob `4396f7a3594369ea3a38c6c0ebdb620496f9703c`: light background/surface/text/muted/line/accent/focus `#fbfaf8/#ffffff/#241f1a/#716a62/#ded9d2/#b95318/#1769aa`; dark `#121110/#191816/#eeeae4/#aaa39a/#403c37/#ef8a4c/#75bfff`.

Verification must distinguish explicit deterministic fixtures, actual imported artifacts/backend responses, and new live-provider runs. No fixture fallback in production. Full matrix in CHAT_UI_PLAN.md.

Main reliability session agreed the additive routing and ownership on 2026-11-14 in the coordination record. All request/action IDs and finite camera/control values are validated against saved revisions; providers close in finally. Mutation actions use their captured base without silently rebasing subsequent edits. Main-owned recovery fields retain event-specific source revisions and submitted-versus-accepted attribution.

# Chat UI corrective plan

Status: independently reviewed and approved in one round, with no blocking planning gaps. The reviewer directly operated the baseline in Chromium; approval concerns this corrective plan, not implemented acceptance. The prior `CHAT_UI_VERIFICATION.md` records historical checks, not acceptance of the reopened user failures. Worktree `/tmp/junction-chat-ui-corrections`, branch `feat/chat-ui-corrections`, base integrated main `9a001f3`. All seven prior UI commits were already integrated. Main's uncommitted changes remain untouched; coordination is `/tmp/junction-ui-coordination.md`.

## Scope and ownership

Correct the five reported interaction failures with the existing plain JS UI, Three.js viewer, additive chat-action router and operation endpoints. The user explicitly permits compact visible controls: chat-first no longer means chat-only. Keep exact Chronicle themes. Do not add a frontend framework, renderer, inference runtime, format, provider, dependency or increased inference/reconstruction budget.

| Owner | Files / bounded work |
|---|---|
| Planner | This plan only; respond to independent findings. |
| Root | Coordination, final action/state contract, integration, diagnostics and focused commits. Own new `app/static/workspace-controls.js`/`.css`, `index.html`, minimal `app.js` hooks and dedicated control/provenance browser tests. Own `viewer.js` only if an actual marker gap requires a small correction. |
| Backend implementer | `app/chat_actions.py` and new dedicated action tests; safe router diagnostics and evidence-backed intent repair, whole-document source resolution. |
| Frontend implementer | `app/static/chat-workspace.js` and dedicated controller browser tests: action lifetimes, captured QA context, exact source/view state, public-access compatibility and controller hooks for persistent controls. |
| Independent reviewers | Read-only plan/implementation review; directly use Chromium against actual sources/models and combined interactions. Reviewers do not implement the change they independently approve. |
| Main reliability session | Providers, QA/sufficiency/review, reconstruction/refinement, persistence, public-access enforcement and deployment. No rewrite or replacement of these files. |

Main's pending controller changes add unmapped-answer/floor notices, submitted-value scope/reason, a completed-model polling race fix and comparison-layer behavior. Incorporate only coordinated committed deltas; do not restore whole files or overwrite main's working tree. Preserve integrated `access.js`/`access.css`, gated composer, no automatic paid replay, pinned immutable examples and anonymous conversation suppression. A public-control change must stay within the agreed server policy; client selectors never become authorization.

Main has agreed this corrective ownership and is freezing/reviewing its pending controller delta. Cherry-pick that reviewed commit before controller implementation. Main owns migration of legacy `test_browser*.py`, `test_revision_recovery_browser.py` and `test_sourcefirst_browser.py`; use dedicated corrective tests to avoid overlapping edits. Local isolated browser verification is authorized; do not run concurrent paid requests against the public deployment.

Dependent implementation begins after planning blockers are resolved. Maximum two plan-review rounds; root resolves remaining disagreement with evidence or scope reduction. An implementation blocker remains open until fixed and independently rechecked, or explicitly reported as unresolved.

The controller remains the single owner of selection, tour, navigation state and typed execution. The new compact-control module renders controller state and invokes its deterministic interface; it does not create another state machine or bypass existing operation/access adapters.

## 1. Diagnose factual routing before changing its behavior

Reproduce the exact message **“How many windows does this building have?”** on an actual saved drawing-derived model with originals. Preserve a credential-safe diagnostic for each failing stage: request validation, configured-provider transport/structured response validation, canonical action validation, identity resolution or public-access rejection. Record request correlation, exception class, safe validation field paths/error types, provider usage and outcome; never log credentials, raw request/response values, source bytes or dataset reference answers. The existing catch-all safe error cannot be the only diagnostic. Also capture the first failure; later success is not a diagnosis.

Inspect the actual offending structured shape when available through a private controlled probe, exposing only types/field names in the report. Repair only the demonstrated router contract/prompt/validation mismatch. Keep the existing configured Gemini/OpenAI switch, one intent call, provider closure and strict identity/argument validation. Do not broadly ignore malformed non-null fields, substitute mesh counts, silently retry, or implement a parallel QA pipeline. If the cause is upstream or cannot be reproduced, retain the failure and state the diagnostic limit plainly instead of claiming it solved.

A factual count produces a `question` action and sends the original wording through existing `/api/questions`, including the existing sufficiency gate, source inspection, citations, review and refusals. The intent catalog is navigation data. “How many windows does this building have?” must not be answered from renderable IDs, inventory totals or interpretation coverage. “Select all modeled windows” remains a deterministic selection of saved renderable records, explicitly separate from a source count.

## 2. Whole-document and focused source navigation

Define two distinct cases within the existing source action contract before dependent implementation:

- `show_source` with no object selector and no page means browse the supplied originals at the captured interpretation revision. It opens the retained valid whole-page choice or the first supplied page, never implicitly the focused object. A visible source/page chooser lists all supplied originals using original filename/source-page labels. Opening a collection does not require clarification merely because it has several pages.
- An explicit page resolves against that revision's supplied page catalog. Keep chooser metadata and served image URL on the same revision, including after opening old selected-object evidence. A named source/page ambiguity may ask a focused clarification with discoverable exact choices. Do not interpret absence of a selected object as source ambiguity.
- “Show this object in its original blueprint” uses the captured object's saved geometry revision and exact stored source reference/bbox. Whole-page navigation has no fabricated highlight region. No nearest-object association, tighter crop or changed coordinate system.
- Native IFC has original records, not drawing pages. Expose record guidance/control without an empty or invented blueprint. Public example source/page reads stay manifest-pinned.

Record any small DTO addition (such as an explicit whole-document target) in `CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md` and coordinate it before dependent edits. Prefer the current no-selector semantics and page metadata over a new route or persistence format.

## 3. Persistent compact navigation

After a document opens, show a compact persistent control strip with **Blueprints**, **3D model**, supplied page/source choice (with previous/next where useful), and **Return to selection**. Provide accessible labels/current state and keyboard focus; controls remain discoverable when chat scrolls and at narrow viewport widths. Keep a small theme choice and legend/toggles near the workspace, without restoring sprawling settings panels.

These controls execute local typed actions immediately and never call `/api/chat/actions`. Tabs do not call QA or reconstruction. If no model is saved, the 3D tab shows a clear no-model state and an explicit “Build model” action using the existing operation; clicking the tab itself must not request generation. Missing drawings similarly show accurate native/source guidance. A failed read is recoverable and retains the current usable view.

Switching views preserves the saved model camera, selected IDs, focused object, ordered tour IDs/index and independent visibility settings. Pause an active tour while viewing original evidence without resetting its position; returning alone does not advance or reframe. **Return to selection** is the explicit framing action. “Back to model; next window” continues the same tour exactly once. Page navigation is independent of focused selection: users can browse other pages and then return to the exact selected-object evidence.

## 4. Separate question lifetime from navigation lifetime

Keep the existing immutable submission capture: pause tour synchronously, then capture document identity/epoch, interpretation and displayed geometry revisions, focused ID, selected IDs, camera, tour and navigation epoch before awaiting. Also capture QA clarification/reply context rather than reading a later mutable `state.clarificationReply` at dispatch.

Use explicit per-action execution classes, not one blanket stale-response check:

| Class | Guard and outcome |
|---|---|
| Factual `question` | Validate echoed request/document/revision context. Within the same document, execute once against the captured revision/reference despite orbit, zoom, pan, selection change, page/view switch or another harmless navigation. A later selection cannot replace “this object”. Existing QA revision rules remain authoritative. |
| Workspace navigation | Requires the captured navigation epoch as well as document identity. If the user has since moved the view, suppress only the delayed navigation/camera effect; do not cancel a valid factual question in the same response or show a generic interruption error. Provide a precise unobtrusive status only when needed. |
| Persistent operation | Retain server validation and captured base revision, immutable-example checks and existing job rules. A changed document/revision rejects the operation; never silently rebase or re-target it from current selection. |

Validate response identity before dispatch even when its navigation part is stale. Handle mixed question/navigation batches explicitly: the original source question remains executable without applying stale movement, and no implicit navigation dependency can alter its reference. Do not execute stale dependent navigation after pending reconstruction. Genuine cross-document switches discard undispatched work from the old document; already submitted jobs remain backend-owned and must not move or populate the new document's workspace. Revisions changed during processing stay pinned/visibly attributed; do not treat camera movement as a revision change. Avoid global busy locks and deduplicate dispatch by request identity.

QA completion must not steal the camera, change the current tab, restore old selection or erase the composer. The answer may update its independently controlled highlight set only where mappings are reliable and revision-compatible. Source citations retain their answered revision even if current geometry changed.

## 5. Visible provenance at object and property level

Provide a persistent compact selected-object summary adjacent to the workspace, outside scrolling conversation and independent of overlay visibility. Show original label/stable identity, representation (reconstructed/schematic/unresolved), stored evidence basis, source page/record and revision, plus **Show in original** using the exact stored reference. Retain prior-revision evidence for removed objects with a clear stale/removed label. Selecting an unresolved item shows its evidence and missing-geometry state without inventing a mesh or frame target.

Render property distinctions from existing authoritative fields rather than infer them from rendering: `SceneElement.properties[].origin`, element/floor `assumptions`, `evidence_basis`, relevant scoped assumption rows and saved user-value attribution. Presence marked depicted in source does not establish height, placement, dimensions or every other property. Label source observations as saved source-supported interpretation, derivations as derived with supplied basis where available, user values as user-provided (not observed), display choices as display assumptions, unresolved/unknown fields explicitly, and decorative proposals as non-factual and excluded from QA/counts/IFC export. Missing provenance remains unknown/interpretation; a source button is not a blanket validation badge.

The existing assumptions endpoint returns a revision ID. Only combine its rows with selected geometry when their revisions match; otherwise show the newer interpretation rows separately with their revision or use the pinned scene's own stored assumptions. Do not silently attach current user values to an older displayed object. If additional pinned server data is genuinely needed, propose the narrow interface to the main session before implementation; do not add a parallel persistence/read path.

Show a discoverable legend explaining observation, derivation, user-provided, assumption, unresolved and proposal labels. Manual controls for **Answer highlights**, **Selection highlight**, and **Assumption overlays** are independent. Reuse existing viewer assumption markers; inspect their visibility and selection behavior on real models. Toggling assumptions must not hide selected-object provenance, change camera/selection/tour or make a source-linked presence validate assumed properties. Proposals use their own visible summary and optional host-support link labeled as host evidence, not proposal evidence.

## Verification and acceptance

Start with deterministic regression fixtures for the observed bugs, then actual artifact/HTTP/browser checks and fresh live Gemini runs. Fixtures may delay responses or inject a precise invalid wire shape to make races/failures reproducible; clearly mark them and never put a fixture fallback in production. Do not rerun reconstruction merely to obtain review data. Reuse unchanged saved models/originals, including renderable windows and separately unresolved objects. Use copied isolated stores and record endpoint/provider-call counts to prove navigation/source QA did not invoke extraction/reconstruction/refinement.

The independent plan reviewer must directly operate the baseline browser, including ordinary source navigation and a delayed question plus physical orbit. The independent implementation reviewer must directly perform the changed integrated flow, not merely read tests or screenshots. Minimum acceptance matrix:

1. Exact live window-count question reaches existing QA and produces supported original evidence or an honest insufficiency/unclear refusal; no modeled-count substitution. Preserve any failures with their safe diagnostic stage. Try ordinary paraphrases and focused questions, not only the exact regression string.
2. “Show the original blueprint” with no selected object opens originals. Multi-source/page choices are discoverable and direct; “this object” opens its exact captured bbox/revision. Whole-page viewing adds no invented evidence region. Native record behavior remains honest.
3. Physically orbit, zoom and pan while intent interpretation is pending; also switch Blueprints/3D and pages while intent and QA are processing. The question runs once and completes in chat with captured revision/context, while camera/tab remain where the user put them. Repeat with a changed selected object, multiple concurrent questions and a mixed question/navigation response. Preserve existing clarification follow-up attribution independently for each captured request.
4. A genuine cross-document switch and stale refinement still protect the current workspace. Failed routing, page HTTP failure and rejected mutations retain sources/model and allow another operation; public 401 offers the existing unlock flow without automatic replay.
5. Tabs/page/return-selection work with provider unavailable and anonymous pinned examples without paid requests. No-model tab does not reconstruct; explicit existing build action still works with its original access/review protections.
6. Inspect actual objects with source-supported presence plus assumed height/placement, a user-provided value, derivation and unresolved record. Summary and source link remain visible with assumption overlays off. Each of the three highlight/toggle states can change without changing the other two. Decorative proposals stay distinct and do not change factual counts.
7. Start a tour, switch to the exact original source, return to unchanged model camera/selection/tour position, then advance once. Verify both themes, desktop/narrow layout, keyboard access and no browser errors.
8. Run focused routing/public-access/controller/viewer tests and required repository checks. Test no source coordinates/IDs/revision provenance changes, provider switch retained, immutable examples remain protected, and no paid inference caused by direct navigation.

Completion requires reproduced-failure evidence, the demonstrated fix or explicitly unresolved cause, independent direct-browser review without blocking findings, passing required checks and a new truthful handoff. Record fixture vs actual-artifact vs live-provider evidence separately, latency and residual failures. Focused commits only; no push or main-worktree writes. Historical successful retries and test counts alone do not satisfy acceptance.

The reviewer directly interacted with actual saved11397 and original sources in both themes. Physical orbit/wheel during a delayed deterministic response to the exact window-count question suppressed the valid question action (zero QA posts) and displayed the generic superseded message. Evidence is retained at `/tmp/chat-ui-corrective-review/baseline-report.json` with screenshots. Deterministic intent delay demonstrates the race, not live inference reliability. The reviewer approved this plan and the controller/control-module ownership split without blockers; implementation still needs the full independent browser/live acceptance above.
